summary: Autonomix Medical filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $10.525 million of common stock through Ladenburg Thalmann as sales agent, under a February 28, 2025 ATM agreement. Shares trade on Nasdaq under AMIX, closing at $4.58 on September 8, 2026. Ladenburg receives 3.0% of gross proceeds plus expense reimbursement. No escrow applies; sales may occur at market prices or in negotiated transactions. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any accelerated insider selling or public-float constraints under Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6.
